description: A finite clause set is satisfiable if and only if the clause set obtained by eliminating any one atom is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.elimination_equisatisfiable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Sat (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.eliminate p Γ) ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Sat Γ
